replies.a: gray market pricing a company before it even has a ticker is just vibes with a spreadsheet
replies.b: a price quoted before the bell is a guess; a price you can actually fill is a market. one of those is tradeable
replies.c: everyone wants the pop, nobody wants to be the counterparty at that print

replies.pt: Mantle: 'nomeie qualquer coisa, vai ser tokenizada' e convite ao Trading Floor 9 com @joshuacheong.
replies.a: tokenize my landlord's excuses next pls
replies.b: tokenizing is the easy part. the venue that gives it depth and execution is the one that matters

replies.pt: Hacker da Binance move mais 137.602 ETH (US$ 248,23 mi) para lavagem — numeros da propria fonte.
replies.a: at this point the hacker is the most consistent ETH trader onchain

replies.c: still wild that a five-year-old hack moves more ETH than most 'market' days

replies.pt: MIP-36 revisada em votacao de 19 a 26/11, com a parceria Halo Prime explicada melhor.
replies.a: reading governance proposals is the new doomscrolling and i am not okay
replies.b: gov on the same chain you trade on, no offswitch between the two — that's the whole point of being a Fluxionian
replies.c: the best proposal is the one your users can act on the same day

a listing is not a market.
a price you can't fill is just a rumor with better font.

the chain moved $248M today and nobody asked for an ID or a holiday schedule.
that's the whole pitch, really.

WatcherGuru teve 4 posts de alta engaj (GTA6 5.460 lk, Coreia 5.515 lk, TSMC/China 1.178 lk) mas segue fora por denylist — lacuna declarada, se o Hadukem quiser mudar a regra, e decisao dele.

replies.pt: Mais de 400 funcionarios da Anthropic ja valem US$ 100 mi cada apos o IPO; os 7 cofundadores, mais de US$ 20 bi cada; media por funcionario acima de US$ 40 mi.
replies.a: 400 employees worth $100M each and the intern still has to fill out a timesheet
replies.b: meanwhile the rest of us get the same company at 3am on a sunday. $ANTx on mantle doesn't check the bell
replies.c: an ipo that mints 400 hundred-millionaires overnight is a wealth transfer with a bell on top

replies.pt: Acoes da Anthropic abriram a US$ 111,50 na Nasdaq, alta de ~34% sobre os US$ 83 do IPO, avaliando a empresa em ~US$ 2 tri.
replies.a: opened at $111.50 after pricing at $83. someone's roadshow deck earned its keep
replies.b: the bell rang once. price discovery has been running without it ever since — that's the part onchain markets already had
replies.c: a 34% gap between the pricing and the first print is bankers leaving money on the table

replies.pt: O $ANTx esta no ar — a Anthropic tokenizada desde o primeiro dia de mercado publico.
replies.a: public and onchain in the same afternoon, no paperwork intermission
replies.b: same company, no closing bell. $ANTx trades around the clock on mantle, weekends included
replies.c: day-one tokenization should be the default by now, not the headline

replies.pt: So ~5% das acoes da Anthropic estao no IPO; em um ano o numero de acoes liberadas cresce mais de 12x.
replies.a: 5% of the company is public and the other 95% is watching from the tunnel
replies.b: a listing is not a market — a 5% float is the proof. liquidity and execution are the rest of it, and they don't keep banking hours
replies.c: everyone calling it a $2T company today should read the unlock schedule before the victory lap

replies.pt: GTA 6 virou o jogo mais bem avaliado de todos os tempos.
replies.a: highest-rated game of all time and it hasn't even shipped. trust the process
replies.b: gta 6 took a decade to arrive. tokenized stocks already trade 24/7 while you wait
replies.c: rating a game before playing it is the same energy as pricing a stock before it trades

ficaram_de_fora.motivo: reply de terceiro, sem gancho proprio
mesmo tema do E3, engajamento baixo

ficaram_de_fora.pt: Short da Anthropic virou de +US$ 4 mi para -US$ 2 mi.

replies.pt: SBF investiu US$ 500 mi da FTX na Anthropic; com o IPO, valeria mais de US$ 40 bi — a FTX vendeu por US$ 1,34 bi.
replies.a: sbf made the best trade of the decade and a bankruptcy clerk liquidated it
replies.b: the thesis was right, the custody was the problem. a market that never closes doesn't get auctioned off in a hearing
replies.c: the FTX estate is now the greatest investor of all time and it never wanted the position

replies.pt: A ANTx, acao tokenizada da Anthropic pela xStocks, ja esta na Monad — via Uniswap, 1inch e Kuru, 1:1 lastreada.
replies.a: an ipo that ships to four chains before your coffee cools
replies.b: distribution is the easy part. depth is the work — a listing is not a market, liquidity and execution on mantle are
replies.c: every chain racing to list the same stock is the clearest sign the token was never the hard part

replies.pt: Bitcoin caiu abaixo de US$ 62 mil.
replies.a: btc under 62k and my group chat is suddenly full of macro analysts
replies.b: btc doesn't check the clock and neither do the stocks on mantle. 'market closed' stopped being an excuse
replies.c: 62k isn't a level, it's a mood

replies.pt: Grupo de ransomware n0n vazou dados de clientes ligados a Visa, Mastercard e JPMorgan, segundo o WSJ.
replies.a: a ransomware group called n0n and still more coherent than half the roadmaps i read
replies.b: your card data sits in someone else's third party. a position on mantle sits with you. different risk, different file
replies.c: the breach is always the third party. at some point third party is just the whole industry

replies.pt: Bridgewater diz que incidentes ciberneticos quase dobraram desde o fim do verao, de ~4.000 para ~10.000 ao ano.
replies.a: cyber incidents doubled and my password is still the one from 2019
replies.b: 1,500 incidents in 2017 to 10,000 now. the risk runs 24/7, the venue should too
replies.c: cyber is the only sector that has never had a down quarter

notes_pt: Fecho de 19/11 (Fortaleza). Dia com tres entregas e 20 itens: edicao da manha as 09:02 (5 replies, 3 posts, 2 memes), card das 15:00 (5 replies, em texto no DM) e card das 18:00 (5 replies, em modal). Este arquivo foi MESCLADO sobre o que a manha ja tinha gravado (commit d4a4a5d): as editions anteriores foram preservadas e as duas da tarde e da noite foram acrescentadas, junto com os 10 links novos em anti_dup_urls_2026-11-19 e o escolhas_log com os 20 itens do dia. Nenhuma escolha do Hadukem em 19/11: ultima fala dele no DM foi em 18/11, entao todo item entrou como 'sem escolha' / 'porque nao informado' e o page ficou como estava — nada publicado. O que ficou de fora: 5 itens na tarde (Sky, Bybit, Securitize, lookonchain, Robinhood), todos por gancho fraco, tema repetido ou posicao de terceiro. Lacuna declarada: os packets dos tres reporteres nao subiram no empresa-ops hoje, entao reporter_tips veio vazio e o reporter_eod ficou nulo; a mesa montou o dia pelo scan proprio. Inconsistencia registrada em quality_feedback: a manha descartou WatcherGuru por denylist e a tarde e a noite usaram 4 posts da mesma conta. | 19/11 22:11: Hadukem liberou a WatcherGuru nos tres slots; a pergunta saiu de pending e virou style_rule.
